book.name: Mark
book.title: Yesu Keriso Tuyeghana Ahiꞌahina Mark Vivireina i Girugirumiya

content: Yesu i Vomahirime
Maranai viyagohina maratomna* i verauvira, yana Mary Magdalene ma Mary, James ayona,
ma Salome, oyohi jimujimumuna hi gimarai po Yesu au tupuwana hita mutui.
Ma Sande
hubahubanai boiboghi yana hi naenae au kokowaga.*
Ma hi raubayadanameehi hipa, “Apo aiya ghaꞌimana au mataꞌeta ina vitovira riyei aubaita?”
Ma hita rauꞌiyau ghae yana ghaꞌimana ghaeghaenana boiboghi hi vitovira riyei.
Eghabaine anima hi rui kokowaga auhinenina ma hewari vouna gara wakewakekena i oteni ma au ahoꞌohohihi i tughutughura ma hi tughohorei.
Ma nahidana i riwehi ipa, “Egha ona ghohoghohorimi! Taumi yana Yesu Nazarethei hi tupatuparatuiya o baibaihei. Tauna yana egha wehidana! Boiboghi i vomahirime. O inanai, wehidana tupuwana hi viꞌenoi.
Ma ona nae po a tauvotagho ma wate Peter maiteni ona riwehi onapa, “Tauna yana i aitayaha po e naenae au Galilee. Nahidana apo Yesu ona inanai me rorova i ririwemi nanaꞌarena.”
Ma maranai we hi nonori yana kokowagei hi hopu, po hi rubaruba yana a tatavahi ma hi vinuwanaina, aubaina au tayaha egha aiya aiwa ghehauna hita riwei babana hi rovo.
Yesu, Mary Magdalene auwarina i Hegha
[Sande hubahubana boiboghi maranai Yesu hiragheei i vomahirime, yana Mary Magdalene auwarina i ai hegha. Na Maryna yana aunaona auwarina aruwa apoꞌapoehi 7 i raukaiwenihi.
I nae po a tauvotagho hi nuwaboya ma hi toutou ma i pariverehi aiwa i tuputupuwa.
Ma maranai hi nonori da Yesu i vomahirime ma tauna i inanai, yana egha hita vitumaghanei.
Yesu, a Tauvotagho Ruwagha auwarihi i Hegha
Ma muriyai, Yesu a tauvotagho ruwagha Jerusalemei hi hopu po tayahei hi naenae, ma auwarihi ana hegha yana inana tapuna. Yamna aubaina ma egha hita inana tuhaghai.
Ma maranai hi inana tuhaghai yana hi wanavirahi po ahi rava ghehauhi hi pariverehi, wate egha hita vitumaghanehi.
Yesu, a Tauvotagho* 11 auwarihi i Hegha
Ma muriya dumai, Yesu a tauvotagho 11 hi amꞌam ma auwarihi i hegha. Po i enihi babana a vomahirime aumurina tauꞌinanaina yana egha hita vitumaghanehi,* ma nuwanuwahi i toghara.
Ma i riwehi ipa, “Ona hopu po ona nae dobu atapuna auwarina, ma rava atapuhi auwarihi po tuyeghaꞌu ahiꞌahina ona rauguguyei.
Ma rava aiya i vitumaghana po i babataito* yana apo ina yawahana, ma aiya egha itai tumaghana yana raibahibahi ina viꞌaroni.
Tauvitumaghana apo manini a verehi po matakiraha hina vogheꞌetehi. Ma wavaꞌuwei apo aruwa apoꞌapoehi hina raugagihi,
ma apo pona vouhi hina vibabaniyehi.
Apo mota nimahiyei hina vohepai ma waꞌiyawa ani hiraghe hina umai yana apo egha viuva ina verehi. Ma rava doridoriꞌahi hina votepanihi yana apo kamnahi ina ahi.”
Maimaituwa, Yesu i Ghaiyei au Mara
Bada Yesu, i vibabani a tauvotagho auwarihi po aumurina, ma i vohepa po i ghae au mara, po Maimaituwa au ahoꞌohohina i tughura.

Anima a tauvotagho dobu dobuwai hi nae ma tuyeghana ahiꞌahina hi rauguguyei. Ma Bada maiteni i bagibagihi ma i vohaguhi po a maniniyei, dewa anivinuwanaina hi dewadewahi ma au ponahi rava hi inainana yana hipa moina.]

footnotes.text: We Maryna yana au Mark 15:40ma Mark 15:47.
Mai Judea* ahi mumuga po oyohi jimujimumuna au tupuwa he mutui ma muriyai au kokowaga* he tereterei, ma waivinehi we mumugana hi votaghoi.
Sande yana mai Judea ahi maratom tayatayahana.
Yesu tuyeghana ahiꞌahina Mark i girugirumiya bukana ꞌwadubo dumana ruwagha, yana Mark 16:8auwarina i tumahiri.
